title: Let a caller replay an attributed note with its own idempotency key
outcome: Let a caller replay an attributed note with its own idempotency key
acceptance: An attributed note call that carries a caller-supplied idempotency key returns the same note locator on an identical retry and appends no second note
The keyed note keeps the non-holder observation route: a project-bound non-holder may still note open or blocked work, and a completed item still accepts a late note
The same key with different note content is refused with a stated reason instead of appending
